title: Taste of Nashville Food & Sightseeing Tour
includes: 3-Hour Food & Sightseeing Guided Tour of Nashville
Pass by sights such as Capitol, Bicentennial Mall, Sounds Stadium, Marathon Village, Nissan Stadium
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
All featured food and drink is included. Where alcohol is a featured item, it is included.
Guests must be 21 or older to consume alcohol. Guests under 21 or not inclined to drink alcoholic beverages will be offered a substitution.
Water is provided at all food destinations - alcoholic beverages may be available for sale at your own additional expense at some locations.

Guests 14 and older are welcome. All guests must be registered. Sorry, infants cannot be accommodated as ride-alongs, with or without a car seat. Families with younger children may want to consider a private tour.
Guests who are intoxicated or disruptive to other participants may be asked to leave the tour without refund.
Note that there are two Harrison Streets in Nashville. Be sure to come to ZIP 37219 downtown
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On this fun and delicious tour, sample the best of Nashville's classic cuisine and visit some amazing places along the way. We'll enjoy a frosty local cocktail, taste hand-made spirits, visit a bakery with a history, enjoy Centennial Park, where you'll learn about the Parthenon, Vanderbilt, and more. Experience whole-hog barbecue at it's very best and learn the secrets that make it so amazing. Feel the heat with authentic Nashville Hot Chicken. Lots of food, fun, and local insights! 

Along the way, you'll see sights such as the Capitol, Bicentennial Mall, Sounds stadium, Germantown, the Cumberland River, Marathon Village, East Nashville's Five Points, Nissan Stadium, and much more!

We may substitute or alter the specific stops and foods, based on daily closures or events.

Travel in our comfortable high-roof touring van with a knowledgeable and fun local guide. The very best way to experience Nashville's neighborhoods, history, and amazing local foods!
